cards.explanation: The answer is Pray. Luke says Jesus "…went out to the mountain to pray…" Just before this, some people "were filled with rage" (Luke 6:11), and in those days Jesus heads off to pray to God. I think that tells you where He turns first.
The answer is False. Luke says Jesus "…spent the night in prayer to God." That's the whole night, friends, and daylight comes in the very next verse. A short while it was not.
The answer is twelve. Luke says Jesus "…chose twelve of them…" He picks them out of the larger group of disciples, and the names come right after.
The answer is Apostles. Luke says Jesus chose twelve "…whom He also designated as apostles…" So these twelve get a name of their own, picked by Jesus Himself.
The answer is Peter. Luke says "Simon, whom He named Peter…" Jesus is the One who gives him the name. His brother Andrew comes right after him in the list.
The answer is Zealot. Luke lists "…Simon called the Zealot…" That tag is how you tell him apart from the other Simon, the one Jesus named Peter. Two Simons on one team needs a little help, friends.
The answer is a traitor. Luke ends the list with "…Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor." This one is heavy to read, friends. The writer tells us this about him right there in the list.

The answer is to hear Him and be healed. Luke says "They had come to hear Him and to be healed of their diseases…" They came for two things: to hear Him and to be healed. That's the reason the text gives for this crowd.
The answer is True. Luke says "…those troubled by unclean spirits were healed." It sits right there next to the diseases, friends. And Luke says power was coming from Him and healing them all.
The answer is touch. Luke says "The entire crowd was trying to touch Him…" They weren't only watching from a distance, bakers, they were reaching for Him.

The answer is that power from Him was healing every one of them. Luke says they were trying to touch Him "…because power was coming from Him and healing them all." The power was coming from Jesus, and the healing reached them all.
